adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.partnering: Young women place betel nuts into the bags of chosen partners.

signature_moves.description: Participants hold hands in a circle to keep away bad souls.
signature_moves.name: Circle dance

music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by a lead vocalist singing traditional, serious songs while a chorus of participants responds, creating a rhythmic vocal foundation for the circle dance.
music_profile.vocal_style: One person leads a chorus and others follow.

basic_steps: Form a circle with other participants.
Execute rhythmic walking steps in a circular path.
Transition into running or jumping movements as led by the soloist.
teaching.level_notes: The dance is communal and inclusive of all ages, but requires adherence to the lead singer's cues.
